policy.basis: Each result and Agent turn creation timestamp
policy.live_agent_protection: Valid lease, at most the existing two-hour execution limit
policy.backups: 90 days from backup file modification time; separate window from online records

gateway_unittest.scope: Boundary, dry run, recent records, active references, memory reset, safe file pruning, SQLite page reclamation, policy API and accelerated scheduler

production_build.warnings: Existing third-party use-client directives and large scientific viewer/editor bundles

browser_built_site.scope: 11 model pages, Ketcher molecule/reaction, Mol*, home shortcuts, Agent streaming/memory, retention and complete JSON downloads

policy.basis: Each result and conversation turn expires 90 days after creation.

excluded: Shared n8n database, reference databases, model weights, external backups and other projects
limits: Gateway downtime delays cleanup until startup.
Database cleanup is batched for bounded lock duration; backlog continues on later passes.
Backup copies have their own 90-day file-age rotation.
Browser model regression uses fixtures and does not revalidate scientific accuracy.
